dashboard.label: RedForesight — Predictions
dashboard.description: Ranked next-move predictions from the red-team AI agent, written back from Splunk.

search.query: index=main sourcetype=_json source=redforesight_agent | spath brief_id | spath signal_summary | spath tactic_classification | spath top_prediction.technique_id | spath top_prediction.technique_name | spath top_prediction.probability | spath top_prediction.reasoning | spath top_prediction.confidence_tier | eval Reasoning=substr('top_prediction.reasoning',1,140)."…" | eval Prob=round('top_prediction.probability'*100,1)."%" | table _time, brief_id, signal_summary, tactic_classification, top_prediction.technique_id, top_prediction.technique_name, Prob, top_prediction.confidence_tier, Reasoning | rename brief_id AS "Episode ID", signal_summary AS "Signal", tactic_classification AS "Tactic", top_prediction.technique_id AS "Predicted TTP", top_prediction.technique_name AS "Technique", Prob AS "Probability", top_prediction.confidence_tier AS "Confidence", Reasoning AS "LLM Reasoning" | sort - _time

index=main sourcetype=_json source=redforesight_agent | spath brief_id | spath ranked_predictions{}.technique_id AS tech_id | spath ranked_predictions{}.technique_name AS tech_name | spath ranked_predictions{}.tactic AS tech_tactic | spath ranked_predictions{}.probability AS tech_prob | spath ranked_predictions{}.splunk_hunting_query AS hunt | eval Prob=round(tech_prob*100,1)."%" | table _time, brief_id, tech_id, tech_name, tech_tactic, Prob, hunt | rename brief_id AS "Episode", tech_id AS "TTP", tech_name AS "Technique", tech_tactic AS "Tactic", Prob AS "Probability", hunt AS "SPL Hunting Query" | sort - _time, Prob
